user_reviews.Name: PAVITRA EPISODES
user_reviews.Description:
We booked this hotel after seeing its profile on Google. We trusted what we saw online. But the reality was completely different — and heartbreaking.

The moment we entered the room, we realized we had been misled. The room was poorly maintained and looked nothing like the pictures on Google. The bedsheet was dirty and stained, and there was a strong, unpleasant smell throughout the room. The mattress felt old and uncomfortable, and even the pillows seemed unclean.

The washroom was worse. There were stains on the tiles, the sink was not properly cleaned, and there was a constant bad odor. The walls had marks and peeling paint, giving the entire room a neglected and unhygienic look. It felt like basic cleanliness was completely ignored.

What hurt us the most was realizing that the Google profile seemed totally fake or at least extremely misleading. The photos and positive image shown online did not match the actual condition at all.

We felt cheated and emotionally disappointed. This was not just bad service — it was a complete betrayal of trust.

user_reviews.Name: Mang Sian
user_reviews.Description:
Review for Hotel Trendy Residency, Chhatarpur

I stayed at Hotel Trendy Residency recently, and unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing. At check-in(19th and 20th November 2026), I was charged ₹1500 per night for two nights (₹3000 total), and additional transaction fees were added for card payment. Later, I discovered that the actual online prices for the same rooms range between ₹700–₹1000 per night. This was the first sign of overcharging and lack of transparency.

The room conditions were far below acceptable standards. There was no water supply, the telephone inside the room did not work, the TV was non-functional, and despite being promised complimentary drinking water, none was provided. The mobile network signal inside the room was almost nonexistent, and their Wi-Fi was extremely slow and practically unusable.

Throughout the stay, there was no proper assistance from the staff regarding any of these issues. At checkout, I explained everything to the same staff member who handled my booking (Truecaller shows his name as Gopal Gupta). Instead of addressing the problems, he behaved in an unprofessional manner, using inappropriate and abusive language. When I recorded the call, he suddenly changed his tone, which shows a complete lack of responsibility and integrity.

Overall, this has been one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had. The service quality, staff behaviour, and basic facilities were extremely poor. I do not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable or professional stay.

user_reviews.Name: PRIYANKA SINHA
user_reviews.Description: I booked the room through booking.com. The hotel charged us more than the Booking.com bill. They charged us as much for early check-in as was the charged of a single day stay on the booking.com. the rooms were not clean and there were no lights in the bathroom and electricity oitlets were not working, so I couldn't even charge my phone. I demanded to get a change of room and I had to look into 5-6 rooms to find one which was relatively ok to stay. That room was not cleaned, the bathroom had hair from the previous guests and when I asked to get the bedsheet changed as it had holes and hair on it, they siad that it was cleaned and other bedsheets were like that only. Then the floors were not clean. The rooms did not have any keys to lock it. Also, there were water issue everyday for which they just said we are working on it. We paid for the breakfast and they did not serve us that even one morning. We were not provided with soap, shampoo, or towels. Overall the stay were terrible and because they made me pay before showing the rooms and later when I said that I do not want to stay given the condition of the rooms, they refused to refund me the money, and as I needed the room just to sleep, I didn't think it was financially wise for me to pay two hotels for the stay, which is why I stayed there. When I called the office staff for breakfast (because the receptionist said that he cannot do anything to help me), these staffs were rude to me. I will not recommend anyone to stay in this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Bharat Singh
user_reviews.Description:
A true 5-star experience that exceeded all expectations!
​From the moment we checked in, our stay at HOTEL MAYDA PRIME Near Delhi Airport was simply awesome. This hotel is a fantastic choice for anyone seeking luxury, convenience, and impeccable service near the airport.

​🍽️ The Culinary Delight (Good Food Serving in Room)
​The highlight of our stay was the absolutely delicious food and the excellent in-room dining service.
​Gourmet In-Room Dining: The menu offered a wonderful variety of cuisines, and every dish we ordered for room service was delivered promptly, piping hot, and beautifully presented. It was a genuine pleasure to enjoy restaurant-quality meals in the comfort of our own room.
​Quality and Taste: The ingredients were fresh, and the flavors were outstanding. They truly went above and beyond to cater to our preferences, making every meal a memorable part of our trip.
​
🛌 Awesome Stay: Comfort, Cleanliness, and Service
​The overall stay was nothing short of awesome, thanks to the high standards of the property and the dedicated staff.
​Comfortable & Clean Rooms: Our room was spacious, immaculately clean, and featured premium bedding that guaranteed a restful night's sleep. The modern amenities and quiet ambiance provided a perfect retreat from the city's hustle.
​Impeccable Service: The staff were polite, attentive, and incredibly helpful throughout our stay. Their efficiency and warm hospitality made us feel truly valued as guests. From check-in to check-out, every request was handled with professionalism and a genuine smile.
​Location: Being so close to the Delhi Airport (IGI) made our travel logistics stress-free and convenient.
​In summary, if you are looking for an airport hotel that delivers a stellar experience with fantastic, high-quality food served right to your room, look no further than Hotel Mayda Prime. Highly, highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Julia Kozera
user_reviews.Description:
Very okay hotel. It is in an old building, which has its pros and cons.

Overall pros:
- good value for money
- away from the hustle and bustle of the street
- the room was spacious, with a high ceiling
- even in the hottest weather (current temp. in New Delhi is 42*C) it heats up much less than in other hotels
- the water in the bathroom also remains pleasantly cool
- large, comfortable bed
- we were lucky that our room had a window and was bright
- quiet fan
- towels, they are not snow-white, but they are clean and stay fresh for a long time (usually after 3..4 uses hotel towels start to smell bad - these do not)
- access to drinking water
- large and pleasant lobby
- there is an elevator
- good Wi-Fi
- spacious terrace with a view, where you can also dry your laundry
- ZERO bugs

- the staff is very friendly, kind and discreet (both at the reception and the gentlemen taking care of cleanliness) 🙂
- I also think that they are friendly to LGBTQ+ people 🏳️‍🌈

Cons
- the room and bathroom are a bit worn out, but it doesn't affect functionality
- the floor in the bathroom and room, sink, mirror, countertops of cabinets and tables are also a bit dirty and neglected; they are rather dusted than washed (acceptable for me, but it may bother someone else)
- it happens there is water shortage from time to time, but it doesn't last long
- when we were checking out, some gentleman (maybe a superior) who appeared from time to time at the reception, stopped us trying to arrange the payment. This caused us to be seriously late for the bus. He could have done it so many times before when he saw us. He could also have been overseeing the formalities as they happened.

If someone after visiting this hotel is going to point out the paint peeling off the wall or a small hole in the sheet, they should better go straight to a 5-star hotel and not ruin the rating here.

Generally, we booked 2 nights and ended up staying for 9.
I highly recommend this hotel, as long as your expectations aren't too high.
Thank you for your hospitality. 💙

The hotel charged us ₹1,500 for the booking and an additional ₹700 for the late checkout. We requested some flexibility considering the situation, but the staff did not accommodate our request.

Regarding the room, it was not well-maintained the walls had damp patches, there was no space to open the window, and the overall cleanliness was below expectations. The TV and telephone were not working, which added to the inconvenience. Despite these issues, we did not complain during the stay, but it certainly impacted the experience.

The stay served its purpose, but the lack of flexibility, poor maintenance, and non-functional amenities left us disappointed. Improving room conditions and customer service would make a significant difference

If you value your safety and peace of mind, please avoid this hotel at all costs. There are many better and safer options nearby.
